notes.title: Release date change
notes.content:
Hey people who played the demo 

first off thanks for playing the demo, sadly due to a global pandemic causing Online school to kick my butt, I have to delay the release date until next year; I'm sorry. 

The Release date is a maxim amount of time I'm letting my self work on the game. So it might come out earlier.

thank you for dealing with this, and keep fighting the Pandemic.

-G2
